explication: eve is a filesystem-first framework for authoring and operating durable AI agents. A developer defines agent configuration and instructions, then adds tools, skills, channels, and schedules; the runtime handles incoming work as sessions and can invoke tools or delegate to subagents. Channels expose HTTP or WebSocket routes, while session APIs support streaming and control. The README documents authoring capabilities; sampled runtime sources confirm route contracts and task cancellation, but do not expose the full dispatch implementation, so uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
